meta.title: Support
meta.description: Help with getting started on Hournook, sharing your booking page and billing, and how to reach us.

hero.title: How can we help?
hero.lead: Quick guides for the things people ask about most. If you’re stuck, the contact details are at the bottom of this page.

steps.account: Create your account and verify your email address.
steps.details: Add your business details, logo and time zone.
steps.services: Add services with their length and price.
steps.hours: Set your weekly hours, then add holidays or closed days.
steps.team: Invite team members and choose which services each person offers.
steps.publish: Publish your booking page when you’re happy with it.

steps.link: Copy your booking link and add it to your Instagram bio, Google Business Profile or email signature.
steps.widget: Paste the embeddable widget code into your own website so customers can book without leaving it.
steps.qr: Download the QR code and print it for your counter, window or flyers.
steps.analytics: Check analytics to see which of these brings in the most bookings.

steps.trial: Your {days}-day free trial starts when you sign up. No card needed.
steps.subscribe: Subscribe for {price}/month from your billing settings when you’re ready.
steps.portal: Open the Stripe billing portal to update your card, download invoices or cancel.
steps.vat: The price includes VAT (24%). You receive an invoice for every payment.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.lead: Tell us what you were trying to do and, if you can, the email address on your account. Please don’t send passwords or card details.
contact.soon: Support contact coming soon. In the meantime, the guides above cover the most common questions.
contact.customers: Booked an appointment with a business? Please contact that business directly; you’ll find their details on their booking page and in your confirmation email.
